newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: One-month to one-year Saudi t-bill rates steady.
newsitem.headline: One-month to one-year Saudi t-bill rates steady.

text.p: Yields were steady on one-month to one-year Saudi treasury bills worth two billion riyals offered by the Saudi Arabian Monetary Agency (SAMA) on Tuesday, bankers in the kingdom said.

The yield on 28-day bills was steady at 5.3585 percent and the rate on 91-day bills was unchanged at 5.4836 percent. Yields on 182-day and 364-day bills were also flat at 5.5444 and 5.7302 percent respectively. They were priced at 99.58496, 98.63281, 97.27344 and 94.52344.
One-month interbank deposit rates were quoted at 5-1/2, 3/8 percent, three months were at 5-5/8, 1/2 percent, six months were at 5-11/16, 9/16 and one year funds were at 5-7/8, 3/4.
